rationale: B is better because it correctly identifies append-heavy insert behavior as transactional, adds useful cold-start and provisional-label handling, and recommends a calibrated supervised model with uncertainty routing. Its formulas still need repair—especially the positive log(IUR) term in a master-oriented score, unbounded fan-in/fan-out expressions, and several weak domain generalizations—but A reverses the insert-to-update signal in its main table, a more serious error in what it calls the strongest discriminator.
